claims.citation: New York Herald, 21 July 1866, p. 3, col. 2
claims.verbatim:
Bark Gazelle (Brem), Meyer, Bremen, 46 days, in ballast
and 199[?] passengers, to Cæsar & Pauli. Had one death (an
infant) on the passage. July 4, lat 46 08, lon 50 21, spoke
fishing schr Imogene, of Bucksport, Me; had just arrived on
the fishing ground.
